summary.text: Dave Madsen is a Democratic state representative from Pennsylvania House District 104 who took office in December 2022 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He previously served on the Harrisburg City Council.

paragraphs.text: Dave Madsen graduated from Middletown Area High School in 2004 and earned a B.A. in political science and an M.A. in European studies.
Madsen served on the Harrisburg City Council from 2017 to 2023.
He succeeded Susan Helm in the Pennsylvania House of Representatives, assuming office on December 1, 2022.
In the 2023-2024 session, he was assigned to the House Appropriations, Committee on Committees, Urban Affairs and Housing, Human Services, and House Local Government committees.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on May 19, 2026.
